faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.q1: What is the Malaysia My Second Home (MM2H) programme?
faq.a1: MM2H is a long-term residency programme run by the Malaysian government that allows foreign nationals to live in Malaysia on a renewable pass, with terms ranging from 5 to 20 years depending on category. It suits retirees, families, investors, and remote professionals looking for a second home in Southeast Asia.
faq.q2: Who is eligible to apply for MM2H?
faq.a2: Eligibility depends on your chosen category. Platinum, Gold, and Silver require a minimum principal applicant age of 25; the SEZ/SFZ categories require a minimum age of 21. All applicants must also show proof of the required fixed deposit and meet the income and property requirements set by the One Stop Centre MM2H.
faq.q3: Can I include my family in my application?
faq.a3: Yes. A legal spouse, unmarried children up to age 35, and parents or parents-in-law can be included as dependents on the same application, subject to the applicable processing fee per dependent.
faq.q4: How long is the MM2H visa valid for?
faq.a4: Validity depends on category: Platinum is 20 years, Gold is 15 years, Silver is 5 years, and both SEZ/SFZ tiers are 10 years. All terms are renewable, subject to continued compliance with programme conditions.
faq.q5: What are the financial requirements to apply?
faq.a5: Each category requires a fixed deposit placed in a Malaysian bank: USD 1,000,000 for Platinum, USD 500,000 for Gold, USD 150,000 for Silver, and USD 65,000 or USD 32,000 for SEZ/SFZ depending on age. Platinum, Gold, and Silver also require a compulsory residential property purchase at or above a set minimum price.
faq.q6: Can MM2H visa holders buy property in Malaysia?
faq.a6: Yes. Platinum, Gold, and Silver categories require a compulsory residential property purchase at or above the minimum price set for that category. SEZ/SFZ categories follow the minimum price set for the relevant Special Economic Zone development.
faq.q7: Is foreign income taxed once I hold MM2H status?
faq.a7: Foreign-sourced funds, income, and profit earned on your MM2H fixed deposit are exempt from Malaysian tax under current programme rules. Malaysian-sourced income may still be taxable depending on your circumstances.
faq.q8: What documents are required to apply?
faq.a8: Typical requirements include a valid passport, proof of income or savings, a medical examination report, a police clearance certificate, passport-sized photographs, and — where dependents are included — marriage and birth certificates. Exact requirements vary by nationality and category, and all documents must be properly translated and certified where required.
faq.q9: How long does the MM2H application process take?
faq.a9: Processing times vary by category and how quickly documents and financial requirements are completed, but applicants typically move through initial submission, in-principle approval, deposit placement, and final visa issuance across several months. Working with an experienced advisor helps avoid delays caused by incomplete documentation.
faq.q10: Do I need to stay in Malaysia full-time with MM2H?
faq.a10: No. Platinum, Gold, and Silver categories require a minimum stay of 90 days per year only if the principal applicant is under 50; there is no minimum stay requirement for those aged 50 and above. SEZ/SFZ categories follow the same age-based structure.

mm2hNew.title: MM2H New Application
mm2hNew.legalIntro: A Malaysia My Second Home (MM2H) application is far more than filling out forms; it is a high-stakes legal and financial submission governed by the Ministry of Tourism, Arts and Culture (MOTAC) and the Immigration Department of Malaysia.
mm2hNew.intro: We manage the full new-application process for every MM2H category, so your submission is accurate and complete the first time.
mm2hNew.step1Text: We review your age, savings, income, and family composition to recommend the right MM2H category for you.
mm2hNew.step2Text: We prepare and check your supporting documents — financial statements, medical reports, and personal declarations — against current requirements.
mm2hNew.step3Text: Your application is submitted to the One Stop Centre MM2H on your behalf, with our team tracking its progress.
mm2hNew.step4Text: Once approved in principle, we guide you through opening a Malaysian bank account and placing your fixed deposit.
mm2hNew.step5Text: We coordinate final processing and collection of your MM2H pass, and brief you on your ongoing obligations.
mm2hNew.sideNote: Exact requirements vary by category and nationality — we confirm your personal checklist during the eligibility assessment.

mm2hRenewal.title: MM2H Renewal
mm2hRenewal.intro: With our expert MM2H renewal services, we help you renew your visa in Malaysia smoothly, on time, and without unnecessary delays. Whether your pass is nearing expiry or you're unsure about the latest requirements, our team ensures your renewal process is handled with precision and care.
mm2hRenewal.intro2: At DCMS MM2H Renewal Services, we focus on accuracy, transparency, and personalised support so you can continue enjoying your life in Malaysia with complete peace of mind.
mm2hRenewal.step1Text: We check your fixed deposit standing, stay-day compliance, and any changes to your dependents before you renew.
mm2hRenewal.step2Text: We refresh supporting documents that may have expired since your original approval, such as medical reports or bank statements.
mm2hRenewal.step3Text: We calculate your exact renewal fee based on your category and process payment through the correct channel.
mm2hRenewal.step4Text: We track your renewal through to approval and confirm your new validity period.
mm2hRenewal.sideNote: Figures per the official One Stop Centre MM2H schedule and subject to change.

banking.title: Banking Assistance
banking.legalIntro: Malaysian banks operate under strict Bank Negara Malaysia (BNM) regulations, stringent Anti-Money Laundering (AML) controls, and thorough Know-Your-Customer (KYC) compliance. Without strategic coordination, foreign applicants frequently face frozen inward remittances, rejection of source-of-wealth documentation, or significant administrative delays that risk missing the MOTAC endorsement window.
banking.intro: Opening and managing a Malaysian bank account is central to your MM2H fixed deposit — we make sure it goes smoothly.
banking.item1Text: We prepare your documentation and accompany you through the bank account opening process.
banking.item2Text: We guide you through placing your MM2H fixed deposit correctly and on time.
banking.item3Text: We help with day-to-day banking questions as you settle in, including approved partial withdrawals.
banking.item4Text: We explain the practicalities of transferring funds into Malaysia for your deposit and living expenses.
